title: Survivin as Predictive Biomarker for RA
brief_summary: Purpose: to examine the possibility of using the onco-protein survivin as a predictive biomarker for identifying individuals at risk of developing rheumatoid arthritis within a cohort of patients seeking treatment for joint pain/stiffness. Secondly, to study survivin as a prognostic marker for joint destruction, refractory and highly active disease in patients with established RA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients seeking treatment at the primary health care for problems with their joints (pain, stiffness).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with RA
study_population: Patients seeking treatment at the primary health care for problems with their joints (pain, stiffness).
